newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilian real falls 0.13 pct on lower mini-band.
newsitem.headline: Brazilian real falls 0.13 pct on lower mini-band.

text.p: Brazil's real dropped 0.13 percent to close at 1.0660 per dollar Friday in the commercial foreign exchange market after the Central Bank lowered the real-dollar mini-band, dealers said.
The Central Bank depreciated the mini-band Friday for the second time this month, lowering it 0.14 percent to between 1.0660 and 1.0710 reais per dollar in a buy/sell auction.
The previous mini-band was set on Tuesday at between 1.0645 and 1.0695 per greenback.
In late afternoon trade, the Central Bank bought dollars at 1.0660 reais per dollar at a buy auction.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real dropped 0.07 percent to end at 1.0704 per dollar.
In the parallel market, the real closed at 1.135 per dollar, down 0.18 percent.
